content.text: So reasonable defaults would be something like:
DSID -> dcterms:identifier
versionable -> fedora:hasVersions (set automatically by fcrepo4)
state -> objState (being added by
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/commit/88766107f78a5d7fd1ebc3044142ea9034617e61)
Seem about right for a default implementation?
Not sure what to do with the URI.   Also noticed that the label isn't in the DatastreamInfo interface.  Do we care about that?
We're working through mapping all the properties
here
for the Islandora migration. Maybe we can coordinate around that if I'm understanding this correctly.
The properties (like label) that can change from version to version are in the DatastreamVersion object.  There are a few others there as well...
Aha, I see those.  Some of those also seem to be set by fcrepo4 and are immutable.
Does the link provided by Nick handle pretty much everything?  Only thing I see missing are the alternate id's and access url.
Those two could be dc:identifier.
Yeah, for stuff for which there's a fedora4 analog field we need to find some other way to include it for historical records of imported objects.  The hydra fedora-migrate project used
http://www.loc.gov/premis/rdf/v1#hasDateCreatedByApplication

for created date. I suspect we can find some suitable predicates.  It's far from my strong suit... while it's important to have a reasonable sample values, we may need to implement something and then get suggestions from the broader community.
Doh! They told me they used dc:dateCreated and dc:dateSubmitted. hasDateCreatedByApplication is way better.
Perhaps I misunderstood the ruby code, but I was basing my assumption off of this:
https://github.com/projecthydra-labs/fedora-migrate/blob/0fde25aa38e17a6e95c4ea138b34a6387d1d3efe/lib/fedora_migrate/content_mover.rb#L50
Nope. That looks right.

ownerId is the tricky one for me. We use it in Islandora, and it is the Drupal user who created the object. In Hydra, a single system user is the one who creates all the Fedora objects. Still not sure what to use a migration predicate, since the way I understand it, we can't shove it into fedora:createdBy.
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/pull/5
Pending a couple review comments, this looks good.
, please go ahead and merge this whenever you are comfortable with the review responses. (squashing as appropriate)
Pending additional code updates.
There's one minor change (placeholder predicate names and values for modificationDate) that I think we should put in, then I'll merge it.
I've pushed more changes to
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/pull/5
to address this.  I still have no button to request review
Resolved with:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/commit/445a67972339f87f055fd949ffe9f7267e4067db
Replace the TODO block here:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/migration-utils/blob/master/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/migration/handlers/BasicObjectVersionHandler.java#L117
The types of properties you might find are the fields in the org.fcrepo.migration.DatastreamInfo interface.
Consider reasonable published RDF predicates to use and apply them to the datastream.
